scenes.text: Myth or fact? You need cash everywhere in Korea.
scenes.quote: You need cash everywhere in Korea.

scenes.text: Cards work almost everywhere, even for a coffee or a convenience store snack. Some street stalls and old markets still prefer cash.
scenes.head: Cards work almost everywhere.
scenes.body: Even for a coffee. Some street stalls still prefer cash.

scenes.text: Pay by card, and keep a little cash for street food.
scenes.rule: Card first. A little cash for street food.

caption:
Do you need cash everywhere in Korea? Myth. 💳

Send this to whoever's coming with you.
